review.assessment:
This change replaces a naive `grep -v '^#'` with an extended regex that correctly accounts for leading whitespace and blank lines, though it restricts comment removal to lines where the `#` is immediately followed by end-of-line.

Defect 1: Fails to remove comment lines containing trailing whitespace after the `#`.
- call: printf '  # \n' | bash solution.sh
- expected: empty output
- actual: '  # '

The regex anchors removal to the absolute end of the line, so any characters (including spaces) following the `#` cause the match to fail and the line is preserved.

findings.defect: Fails to remove comment lines containing trailing whitespace after the `#`.
